description: Rank countries by the price of a fuel type in a region (or worldwide): the cheapest first, or with order=most_expensive the most expensive first. Useful for route planning. Use it for «where is fuel cheapest» and, with order=most_expensive, «where is fuel the most expensive», in a region or worldwide.

fuel_type.description: Fuel type. e.g. gasoline, diesel, lpg, cng, e85.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

order.description: cheapest first (default) or most_expensive first — «where is fuel the most expensive».

region.description: Region to search. Default: world (all countries).

name: find_cheapest_fuel
title: Find Cheapest Fuel
